_comment: ci-reorg-target-debt gate policy (DATA, not code). North-Star Completion Programme bootstrap step T3b: Global Binding Rule 1 (no-new-reorg-target-debt), normative from this gate's admission onward. The six reorg-target forms live HERE as data — the Rust kernel hardcodes no oyatie-specific prefix, path, or name, so another repo adopts this gate by editing this policy (pipeline-as-product). Existing target-prefix estate is migration inventory covered shrink-only by the committed baseline; anything NEW under a target form fails closed. Approved-plan authority: evidence/ralplan/oyatie-north-star-completion-v1-approved-plan-20260812.md; bootstrap evidence: evidence/goals/north-star-completion-t1-hold-lift-receipt-20260812.json, evidence/goals/north-star-completion-t2-execution-authorization-20260812.json, evidence/goals/north-star-completion-option-b-contingency-contract-20260812.json.

target_forms._comment: The six reorg-target forms of Global Binding Rule 1. name_prefixes bind NEW crate/module/binary names and workspace dependency names (Arm B and the dep-name half of audit mode); path_prefixes bind NEW tracked files (Arm A) and NEW work-item evidence anchors (Arm C).

baseline._comment: Arm A baseline strategy: a committed SORTED, DEDUPLICATED LIST OF PER-PATH DIGESTS — the lowercase sha256 hex of each tracked target-prefix path string at gate-authoring time — plus the (empty-at-birth) Arm B dep-digest inventory and the Arm C anchor inventory (anchors stay literal; verified free of scanner-relevant tokens). Digests, not literal paths: the committed file must carry none of the retired vocabulary embedded in migration-inventory path names (brand-residue ratchet blocks NEW files carrying those tokens), while exact set semantics are preserved. Born-blocking zero-NEW ratchet: the gate hashes each LIVE target-prefix path and a digest absent from the list fails closed reporting the exact violating LIVE path. SHRINK-ONLY: removals are always admissible, and a removal REQUIRES baseline regeneration in the same change — a baseline digest matching no live path fails the gate (stale-row detection, mirroring the gate-coverage-baseline re-freeze convention) as a count plus digest-prefix bucket with the regeneration command in the failure message, so burned-down debt can never silently regain headroom.

exemptions._comment: Empty at birth. Each future entry is a reviewed path or path-prefix excluded from Arms A/C and audit mode, carrying its own justification; expansion is a governance act, never a gate-side default.

scan._comment: Read-only filesystem walk parameters for the live-tree collector. On a clean checkout the walk over the target-prefix roots with these directory names skipped equals the git-tracked set exactly (verified at gate authoring); untracked residue under a target prefix fails closed by design.

workspace_manifest._comment: Arm B input: the root workspace manifest's [workspace.dependencies] table (inline-table and subsection forms). Member manifests inherit through the workspace table, so the root table is the single declaration surface this arm binds; zero target-form entries exist at birth, so Arm B is born-green at an empty baseline.

masterplan._comment: Arm C input: the parsed planning SSOT. The evaluator deep-walks the provided JSON value; any string found under one of anchor_field_names (directly or inside an array) that begins with a target path prefix is an evidence anchor under test. This arm is synthetic-fixture-proven at birth and re-binds to the live work-item id space at Wave 1. The two pre-existing target anchors in today's corpus are carried shrink-only in the baseline.

reduction_claims._comment: Arm D contract: an artifact object asserting a net target-surface-reduction claim is refused unless it binds the measurement. All three companion fields are required; before_count and after_count are DATA carried by the artifact under test — this gate never invents or compares numeric thresholds. Any future numeric corridor slot is a NAMED PLACEHOLDER routed to the Wave 5 corridor freeze (see corridor_placeholders).

audit_mode._comment: Deterministic interval audit over an explicit commit range <from>..<to>. Git I/O stays at the CALLER boundary (scm-facts precedent: the gate fleet keeps one out-of-graph git boundary; this crate spawns no subprocess): the caller materializes a captured commit-set JSON and the binary's audit engine — the SAME code path the fixture suite proves — evaluates it. FAIL-CLOSED: a missing, unparseable, empty, incomplete (complete != true, or a commit missing any fact array), or range-less input is a non-zero explicit RTD_AUDIT_INPUT_INVALID finding, never a pass. A commit introducing a file/dep/anchor under a target form relative to the range base is reported per commit and per arm; the report stays red until every finding's commit carries a remediation record. The report is machine-readable JSON suitable for committing as a durable evidence record.
commit_set_materialization: The caller (coordinator) materializes the captured input for <from>..<to> with plain git, outside this crate:

3. per commit added_workspace_path_deps / added_dep_names: entries present in [workspace.dependencies] of the root manifest at <sha> and absent at <sha>^ (objects {name, path}; name-only entries carry an empty path)
4. per commit added_evidence_anchors: anchor strings (per masterplan.anchor_field_names) present in the planning SSOT at <sha> and absent at <sha>^
5. set range.from/range.to to the exact shas and complete=true only when every commit in the range carries all four fact arrays

liveness._comment: Every run — blocking and audit — emits evaluated_path_count and the evaluated_arms list in its report. A missing scheduled run is a GAP, never a pass: absence of a report is absence of evidence, and no consumer may treat a silent interval as green.

corridor_placeholders._comment: No numeric threshold is minted by this gate. Any future numeric corridor slot (e.g. a maximum admissible target-surface size) is a named placeholder resolved only by the Wave 5 corridor freeze.

product_contract.born_pack_shaped: Target forms, baseline location, scan parameters, manifest/masterplan paths, anchor field names, claim schema, and exemptions are DATA here; the Rust kernel fixes only the evaluation ALGORITHM.
product_contract.ratchet: Born-blocking at the committed baseline: the live tree is green at ZERO new debt, so any NEW target-form file, dep, or anchor fails closed from the first admitted run.
product_contract.execution: Buck2-native Rust gate under //ci/facade/reorg-target-debt; enforced by the required buck2 lane (buck2 test //ci/...) behind oya-ci-required.

purpose: No-new-reorg-target-debt gate (Global Binding Rule 1). Arm A refuses new tracked files under reorg-target path prefixes against a shrink-only committed baseline; Arm B refuses new workspace dependencies that point into or are named under target forms; Arm C refuses work items whose evidence anchors point under target prefixes; Arm D refuses unproven net-debt-reduction claims lacking a census-bound before/after measurement; audit mode replays Arms A-C over an explicit commit range and fails closed on incomplete input or unremediated findings.
